verdict.rationale: Sentry documents and maintains official SDKs across many platforms, including Python, Rust, Unity, Unreal and Godot, with step-by-step per-platform install guides. For AI-native users, one documented command teaches coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor to install and configure the SDK. Missing for 10: evidence of an official client SDK for the management web API (the listed SDKs are instrumentation SDKs), and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK build experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official Sentry SDKs ... Python ... Rust ... Unity ... Unreal Engine ... Godot Engine
Pick your platform below and follow our step-by-step guides to install the SDK and send your first event.
One command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok how to install and configure Sentry for you.
Drop in the [SDK](https://sentry.io/platforms/). No agents to install.
